description: She wears a dark red floor-length gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and narrow floral woven borders at the neckline, bodice, cuffs and hem. A light patterned underdress is visible at the center skirt, and a red wrap with decorative edging hangs around her forearms. Round shoulder brooches, a narrow belt with a round buckle, a small pendant and rings provide restrained ornament. Brown closed shoes appear beneath the hem; her head is bare.
